pzs3us1/00463/1/25/109.original:
Gogeta is the ultimate warrior,
created by the fusion of Goku and
Vegeta in their Super Saiyan 4 forms.

At Vegeta's suggestion, he and Goku
unite to battle the seemingly
unstoppable Omega Shenron.

Aside from his bright scarlet hair,
Gogeta's characteristics are similar
to that of a Super Saiyan 4:
the upper half of his body is
covered in red fur, and he takes
on a somewhat wild demeanor.
He still wears his previously seen
Metamoran costume.

Having achieved his ultimate power,
Gogeta is able to brush Omega
Shenron aside like an insect. He is
a warrior without peer, and
demonstrates this by performing this
by performing his ultimate finishing
move the "Big Bang Kamehameha"
(a combination of Goku and Vegeta's
signature attacks).

Invincible though he seems,
Gogeta has one serious weakness.
He can only exist for ten minutes
at a time, the duration of
the Fusion Technique.
